items.title: How fast does a shared endpoint's complexity grow per consumer?
items.description: Bramble tried to keep serving web, mobile, and the partner from one smarter endpoint. Drag the number of consumers sharing that one endpoint to see how many consumer-specific conditional branches it ends up needing to track — each new consumer doesn't just add its own logic, it adds a case for every existing consumer it might interact with.
items.compute: const branches = params.consumers + params.consumers * (params.consumers - 1); return { branches };

items.title: How many consumers does one breaking change reach?
items.description: The PR that renamed promoBadge on the shared endpoint would have reached every consumer at once. Drag the number of consumers, and toggle whether a BFF boundary is in place, to see how many consumers a single field rename actually affects — with a boundary, a change made inside one consumer's own BFF stays inside it.

params.name: hasBoundary
params.label: BFF boundary in place (0 = no, 1 = yes)

items.compute: const affected = params.hasBoundary === 1 ? 1 : params.consumers; return { affected };
